subject: Request: stewardship stipend + trial extension for CodeHack Summer Sprint
messages:
From: Alice Morgan <alice@codehack.org>
To: olga.petrov@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 22 Jul 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Stewardship stipend + trial extension for Summer Sprint

Hi Olga,

Thanks again for the intro call last week — CodeHack is running a community-maintained Summer Sprint (Aug 12-15) that brings together 40 maintainers and mentors working on tooling and docs. We had a great conversation with Redwood at the last event and several maintainers are already using Redwood for CI/dev workloads.

Two asks from my side:
- A short trial extension for participating maintainers (we'd like a 6-month trial applied to each participating maintainer account, up to 25 people).
- A modest compute stipend (we were thinking $3k in aggregate) to cover burst GPUs for workshop demos and CI for the sprint projects.

I've attached a short proposal and a draft SOW that outlines how we'd credit and report usage. If you can share the team member who would review this (and any contract or SOW process), that would help us get approvals before the sprint.

Attachments: CodeHack_Sprint_Proposal.pdf (PDF), SOW_draft.docx (Docx)

Best,
Alice
Alice Morgan
Community Lead, CodeHack
alice@codehack.org
From: olga.petrov@redwood.com <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: marcus.lin@redwood.com, vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
Cc: 
Date: Fri, 23 Jul 2027 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Stewardship stipend + trial extension for Summer Sprint

Hi Marcus / Vanessa,

Forwarding a proposal from CodeHack — they run a high-signal maintainer sprint mid-August and are requesting an extended trial for 25 maintainers plus a $3k compute stipend. Proposal attached.

Quick context: this is community stewardship work (maintainers mentoring new contributors) and typically gives good visibility among OSS maintainers; we've run similar smaller programs in the past.

Can you advise:
- Marcus: what level of stipend/credit we can approve out of partner marketing or community budget?
- Vanessa: any legal/finance SOW notes or standard wording we should use (DocuSign/PO required)?

If the team needs it, happy to hop on a 20-min call with CodeHack next week.

Thanks,
Olga
Olga Petrov
Community Partnerships, Redwood Inference
From: marcus.lin@redwood.com <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: olga.petrov@redwood.com, vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 24 Jul 2027 10:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Stewardship stipend + trial extension for Summer Sprint

Thanks for the ping — quick thoughts:
- From a budgeting POV, partner/community marketing has discretionary funds; I can approve up to $2,000 out of that bucket without escalation. Anything above that we'd route through Growth for sign-off and we'd need a one-pager on expected MQL/engagements.
- For trials: we prefer issuing 3-month trial extensions per person (6 months is a little long for precedent). We can do an exception if CodeHack commits to a short post-event report (metrics, participant list, and two short quotes from maintainers) — that helps justify a longer trial.

Practical asks:
1) Vanessa, can Legal/Finance issue a simple SOW template and confirm whether a DocuSign or a PO is required for a $2k stipend?
2) Olga, please get CodeHack to confirm participant count and agree to the post-event report; once we have that I can issue a partner credit code or ledger transfer.

Marcus
Marcus Lin
Head of Growth Partnerships
From: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: marcus.lin@redwood.com, olga.petrov@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 28 Jul 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Stewardship stipend + trial extension for Summer Sprint

Looping in a quick SOW path: for a community stipend of $2,000 we can process as a promotional credit and issue a one-page SOW. DocuSign preferred for signatures, no PO required for promotional/marketing transfers under $5k.

I drafted language for the SOW and uploaded to our Drive (link below). If Marcus signs off on $2k and Olga confirms the post-event reporting requirement with CodeHack, I will:
- Generate the promotional credit code (valid for 6 months, redeemable per maintainer email).
- Send the DocuSign SOW to CodeHack and copy Legal if anything unusual.
- Confirm the accounting ledger code (will provide the GL code in the SOW footer).

Drive link: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3c-codehack-proposal

Vanessa Ortiz
Partner Operations, Redwood Inference
